title: CandidateCoverage
description: Privacy-safe preferred-line candidate-generation diagnostics (ADR-0023). No coordinates, query text, or vendor payloads.

status.description: adequate = preference-covering candidates found when topology allows; degraded = some coverage under budget pressure; exhausted = budget ended without trustworthy preference-covering candidates.

familiesAttempted.description: Candidate-generation families queried for this search.

preferenceCoveringCandidateCount.description: Candidates with satisfactionCount > 0 when preferred lines were requested; equals candidateCount when selectedLineIds is empty.

budgetExhausted.description: True when the candidate/time budget stopped generation.
